$comment: Cyber Safety Lab messages. lines are shown in order; flags = indexes of lines that are red flags (tap them in Advanced). level: entry | advanced | both.

lines: 🎉 CONGRATS! You won a FREE gaming laptop!
Claim in 10 MINUTES or it goes to someone else!
Tap here: fr33-prizes.win/claim
Just enter your parent's card number for shipping.
messages.why: Surprise prizes, countdown pressure, a weird link and asking for card numbers are all scam signs.

lines: Your monthly statement is ready.
Log in at fincitybank.com by typing it yourself to view it.
We will never ask for your PIN or password by email.
messages.why: It doesn't ask for anything secret, uses the real domain and tells you to type the address yourself.

lines: URGENT: Your account will be CLOSED today!
Verify now: http://fincity-bank-verify.co/login
Confirm your username, password and PIN to keep access.
messages.why: Look-alike domain (fincity-bank-verify.co), urgent threats, and asking for your password and PIN.

lines: hey want 10,000 free coins??
just send me your login so i can add them
dont tell ur parents its a secret ok
messages.why: Free stuff for your login, plus 'keep it secret', a classic account-stealing trick.

lines: Don't forget your library books are due today! 📚
Love you!
messages.why: A normal message from someone you know, asking for nothing.

lines: You are owed a $1,284.00 tax refund.
To receive it, pay a $49.99 processing fee with a gift card.
Reply with the gift card code within 24 hours.
messages.why: Tax agencies never charge fees for refunds or ask for gift cards. The domain isn't official either.

lines: 🔒 Secure checkout · orbit-outfitters.com
Order total: $54.20 (incl. tax)
Pay with card or FinPay
messages.why: The real store's domain, a normal price and normal payment options. (Still check the URL carefully!)

lines: MOON SNEAKERS 90% OFF, TODAY ONLY
Payment: crypto or wire transfer only
messages.why: The 0 in '0utfitters', impossible discounts and untraceable payment methods signal a fake store.

lines: We'd love to hire you as a remote 'payment processor' for $900/week!
We'll send you checks; deposit them and wire back 80%.
Keep 20% as your pay.
messages.why: A fake-check scam: the checks bounce later and you owe the bank everything you wired.

lines: Fin City Delivery: your package is held.
Pay $1.99 redelivery fee: fcdeliv.ry/pay
messages.why: Small 'fee' texts with odd short links are used to steal card numbers ('smishing').

lines: Your daily challenge is ready! Play to earn tickets.
messages.why: An official app notification that doesn't ask for any information.

lines: Hi it's your cousin! I lost my phone, this is my new number.
Can you buy me a $100 gift card and text me the code? I'll pay you back!
messages.why: Impersonating family plus gift-card codes = scam. Call the real person on a number you already know.

lines: A new sign-in to your account from a new device.
If this was you, no action needed.
If not, open the CloudKite app to secure your account.
messages.why: Real security alerts tell you to use the app or type the site yourself; this one asks for nothing.

lines: Guaranteed 100× returns in 30 days!
Celebrities are buying, don't miss out!
Minimum investment $500. Refer friends for bonuses.
messages.why: Guaranteed huge returns, celebrity hype and referral rewards are signs of a Ponzi or pump-and-dump.

lines: gg! that was a fun race 😀
messages.why: Just a friendly message, it doesn't ask for anything.

lines: You won a pony!!! 🐴
Send your home address and your mom's credit card to get it.
messages.why: Nobody gives away ponies by text! Never share addresses or card numbers.

lines: Your Fin City Bank card is LOCKED.
Text back your card number and PIN to unlock it now.
messages.why: Banks never ask for your PIN by text. A scary message plus a request for secrets is a scam.

lines: i can give u the rare dragon skin for free
just log in on my site skinz-free.gg with ur account
messages.why: Free rare items and a strange login site are how accounts get stolen. Only log in through the real game.

lines: Running 10 min late to pick you up from practice.
Wait inside the gym please!
messages.why: A normal message from someone you know, with no links and nothing to send.

lines: Your hold is ready: 'The Secret Garden'.
Pick it up at the front desk within 7 days.
messages.why: No links to click, no money, no passwords. Just a normal library notice.

lines: Hi, is this Jamie? Wrong number sorry!
Btw you seem nice, want to earn $500 a day from your phone?
messages.why: The 'wrong number' chat that turns into a money offer is a common trick to start a scam.

lines: nice save at the end!
want to play another round tomorrow?
messages.why: A friendly message about the game. Nothing to click, nothing to give.

lines: You are visitor #1,000,000!
Spin the wheel to win a new phone!
Enter your name, address and phone number to claim.
messages.why: Being the 'millionth visitor' is a classic trick. They want your personal details.

lines: Reminder: team photos are Saturday at 9am.
Wear your blue jersey!
messages.why: A normal reminder from someone you know. No link and nothing to send.

lines: You have been selected for a $1,000 gift card!
Reply with your parent's bank details so we can send it.
messages.why: You can't win a prize you never entered. Nobody needs bank details to give you a gift.

lines: We detected cheating on your account!
Send your password within 1 hour or you will be banned.
messages.why: Real moderators never ask for your password. Threats and a short deadline are pressure tactics.

lines: Happy birthday sweetheart! 🎁
I put a card in the mail for you.
messages.why: A kind message from family. Nothing to click, nothing to send.

lines: 🔒 fincity-zoo.org
Kids' tickets: $8. Adults: $14.
Pay at checkout with a card.
messages.why: The address matches the real zoo, the prices are normal and it uses a secure checkout.

lines: Mum, I dropped my phone in the toilet 😢 this is my new number
Can you send £200 for a new one? Don't call, the mic is broken.
messages.why: A 'new number' plus an urgent money request and a reason not to call is a known family scam. Call the old number to check.

lines: The school trip form is due Friday.
Please return the paper form to your teacher.
messages.why: A normal school notice that asks you to hand in paper, not to click or pay.

lines: Congrats!! You got 5,000 gems 💎
To claim, enter your parent's card on gem-claim.net
messages.why: Free gems that need a card number on an outside site are a scam.

lines: Your order is on its way! 🍕
Arriving in about 20 minutes.
messages.why: A normal delivery update after you ordered. No link and no payment request.

lines: You won a puppy! 🐶
Send $50 for the puppy's plane ticket.
messages.why: You can't win a pet you never entered for. Paying a 'fee' to get a prize is a scam.

lines: thanks for the help on level 5!
you're really good at this
messages.why: A nice message from another player. Nothing to click or share.

lines: What's your home address?
I want to send you a free toy!
messages.why: Never give your address to people you don't know, even for free stuff.

lines: Dinner is at 6! 🍝
Please feed the cat before then.
messages.why: A normal message from family.

lines: tell me your password and ill double your coins
promise!!
messages.why: Never share your password, not even with friends. Nobody can double your coins.

lines: FREE CANDY FOR A YEAR!
Type your name, school and age to win.
messages.why: Prize pages that ask for your name and school want your personal information.

lines: The pool is closed Monday for cleaning.
See you Tuesday!
messages.why: A normal notice. No links, money or passwords.

lines: Good luck at your recital today! 🎵
We'll be in the second row.
messages.why: A kind message from family.

lines: We noticed unusual activity on your FinPay account.
Your account has been limited.
Review it here within 24 hours: finpay-account-review.com/restore
FinPay Support Team
messages.why: The sender domain is not FinPay's real one, and the link goes there too. Open the real app yourself to check.

lines: Thanks for your order #48213!
It will ship within 2 business days.
Track it any time in your Orbit account.
messages.why: The sender matches the real store, it refers to a real order and it asks for nothing.

lines: Unpaid toll: $4.15.
Pay now to avoid a $50 late fee: fc-toll-pay.info
Reply STOP to opt out
messages.why: Toll texts with odd links are a widespread scam. Check the official toll website by typing it yourself.

lines: Paid internship: $35/hour, work from home!
No interview needed. Start today.
First, buy $300 of equipment from our supplier. We'll refund you.
messages.why: Real jobs interview you and never ask you to pay upfront for equipment.

lines: 🔒 cloudkite.com
Sign in to CloudKite
Email and password
messages.why: The address is the real site, it is secure and you went there yourself. This is where you should log in.

lines: A payment of $72.40 to Grocery Barn posted to your account.
If you don't recognise it, call the number on the back of your card.
messages.why: The sender is the real bank, there is no link and it tells you to use the number on your own card.

lines: Hi! I'm a recruiter. Your profile fits a 'product reviewer' role.
Rate items in our app, earn $200-$800/day.
To unlock tasks, deposit $100 in crypto first.
messages.why: Task-based job scams pay small amounts at first, then ask you to deposit money to 'unlock' more. Real jobs pay you.

lines: Your concert tickets are ready!
Due to high demand, please send payment by gift card.
Tickets will be emailed after payment clears.
messages.why: Legitimate sellers take card payments with buyer protection. Gift cards are untraceable.

lines: Your purchase of 500 coins for $4.99 is complete.
A receipt has been sent to your parent's email.
messages.why: An in-app receipt for a purchase you made, inside the official app.

lines: Fin City Bank Online
Your session has expired.
Re-enter your card number, PIN and the code we just texted you.
messages.why: The real domain is the part right before .com: 'secure-login-help.com', not the bank. Never give a texted code to anyone.
